decisions.note: Every <Link viewTransition> in src/views does nothing: React Router only honours the prop under a data router, and src/App.tsx mounts <BrowserRouter> + <Routes>. Verified by patching document.startViewTransition and clicking a product card — it was never called. So the product-image continuity the SPEC asks for has never run, and the only transition that does fire is withDirectionalTransition() on a filter chip, which slides and scales the whole page (1.06 → 1) on a spring that overshoots — the jerky zoom the team reported. The lab studies drive the transition explicitly (src/lab/subpages/shared.tsx › ContinuityLink) and name only the clicked image, so exactly one pair morphs. Whichever directions are chosen, the fix belongs in src/views too.
decisions.outcome: Fixed. src/App.tsx declares a real route table under createBrowserRouter instead of <BrowserRouter> + a descendant <Routes>. Measured before and after on the running site: a product-card click started 0 view transitions and now starts 1, and the back navigation replays it. A splat route with <Routes> underneath was tried first and does NOT work — a descendant <Routes> matches below the data router, so the Link's prop never reaches the router that would honour it. The other half of the note is also gone: withDirectionalTransition no longer fires on a filter chip, because motion proposal 05 landed in the same pass.

decisions.note: Seed extended from 12 to 77 placeholder products across the same six shops (src/lib/mock/catalogue.ts), with shops crossing categories so filter combinations mean something, three NULL prices for the Liên hệ path, three image slots per product, and a short_desc_vi for every product including the original twelve, which had none. Publication dates use a coprime stride so "mới nhất" interleaves the shops. Still INVENTED placeholder content — it must not ship to a public demo.

decisions.outcome: Team 07/09 chose C. Folded into HeroDeck as a clamp on the ratio itself — aspect-ratio: clamp(1.25, calc(1.25 + (100vw - 375px) / 1562.5px), 1.7778) — shared with the card's max-width calc so the two bounds cannot disagree. Measured on the running page: 1.25 at 375px, 1.33 at 500, 1.46 at 700, 1.59 at 900, 1.71 at 1100, and 1.778 from 1200 up. /lab/hero and the four studies were deleted in the same change, per the same note.
